purpose: Teach: 恵比寿/坊主/生きがい/本命/クラフト/柵/ムーン/フランクフルト

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、家族で、恵比寿のお祭り、行きたいよね、ぼく、楽しみだよ、本当に、お父さんも、喜びそうだよ、絶対。
lines.en: Mom, can we go to the Ebisu festival with the whole family? I'm so looking forward to it. Dad's going to love it for sure.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick pace, genuine excitement bubbling up. Reaches toward the listener. Small pause before 'for sure' — absolute conviction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お寺の坊主さん、毎年、お盆に、来てくださるわよ、翔くん、お話、聞いたこと、ある、覚えてる?
lines.en: Yes. The temple monk comes every year during Obon, you know. Sho, do you remember hearing him speak before?
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful. Gentle lift into the question. She's checking in with him, not testing him. Soft fondness underneath — the tone of someone making space for a child to think.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんの仕事、お父さんの、生きがいなんだって、ママに、よく、言ってるよ、ぼく、すごいって、思うんだ。
lines.en: Dad always tells me his work is what gives his life meaning. I think that's really amazing.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. Slow, careful delivery — he's turning something over in his mind. Small, sincere. No performance, just observation he's proud to share.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達、翔くん、本命の親友、もう、いるの?ママも、知りたいわよ、教えてくれる、嬉しいわよね、こういう話。
lines.en: Do you have a best friend at school yet, Sho? I'd love to know. It's nice when you tell me things like this.
lines.style: Curious and warm, but not pressing. Patient rhythm — she's genuinely interested, not fishing. Slight softness at the end, reassuring him these conversations matter to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんが、クラフトビール、好きなんだよね、ママ、お祝いに、買って、あげるんだよね、お父さんの誕生日に。
lines.en: Dad loves craft beer, doesn't he? I'm going to buy him some for his birthday as a celebration.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact warmth. She's thinking ahead, planning something small and kind. Even rhythm — confident in what she wants to do for him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お庭の柵、お父さんが、修理してくれたわね、翔くん、安全になって、ママ、嬉しいわよ、本当に、感謝してる。
lines.en: Your dad fixed the garden fence so nicely, Sho. Everything's safer now. I'm really grateful to him for that.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. She pauses slightly before 'really grateful' — sincerity settling in. Warm with appreciation, not gushing. The voice of someone noticing care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、おじいちゃんの本で、ムーンランディングの話、読んだよ、ママ、すごく、面白かったんだ、本当に、感動した。
lines.en: I read about the moon landing in your grandfather's book, Mom. It was so interesting. I was really moved by it.
lines.style: Bright, engaged pace. Wonder and genuine delight — he's sharing something that caught his imagination. Slight breathlessness at the end, still caught up in what he felt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夕食、フランクフルトソーセージ、たくさん、買ってあるわよ、翔くん、お腹いっぱい、食べていいよ、楽しみね、本当に。
lines.en: I've bought lots of frankfurters for dinner, Sho. You can eat as much as you want. It'll be fun.
lines.style: Warm, generous affection. Slightly teasing generosity — 'eat as much as you want' lands with gentle indulgence. Close and intimate, the voice of a mother offering comfort in small, concrete ways.
